expected.description:
Collector's Edition

About the Game 
Originally released on Early Access in 2016, Unfortunate Spacemen is a multiplayer game about space-based deception and murder in space! Spacemen work diligently to be rescued from their failing outpost, but not everyone is who they claim to be... Death is part of life in space, and you're no exception to the rule. Paranoia runs rampant.

Shapeshifter Mode: Survive, hunt, or complete randomized objectives to escape, in desolate settlements, arctic outposts, derelict space stations, warp-speed hypertrains, or ancient digsites across 15 distinct alien locales, and up to 16 players per match!
As a Spaceman, complete objectives to call for rescue, or go hunt the Monster in packs!
Mimic and devour the Spacemen as the Monster from the blackest reaches of the galaxy! Lay traps, disguise as other players, or take them head-on in your devestating Monster Form!
As a Traitor, help the Monster win, perhaps even at the cost of your own life!
Solo / Co-op Story Mode: Fight against the Crumerian insect swarm as you battle with up to 5 friends through the bonus story mode!
Solo / Co-op Survival Mode: Survive with up to 9 other friends for as long as you can against progressively more difficult waves of enemies!
Proximity Chat: All in-game communication fades with distance from the speaker, so you can roam, sneak, hide, and eavesdrop as you hunt or run from other players!
Security Guards (Bots) roam the facility. Use them to help learn the ropes and practice, or just add them for more chaos to a multiplayer game!
Rank up through The Company to unlock new customization and perks to customize your look and your playstyle!

installSteps.text: Alternatively, download Unfortunate Spacemen directly from the official site at http://unfortunate.space. Always download from the official source — third-party mirrors of free games are a common malware vector.
Unfortunate Spacemen is also on Steam and is free there. Open the store page and press Play Game to add it to your library.

Run the downloaded installer and follow the prompts. If Windows SmartScreen warns about an unrecognised publisher, that is normal for open-source projects without a paid code-signing certificate — choose More info, then Run anyway.
Launch the game and look at the settings menu before your first session — resolution and control defaults are worth checking. Unfortunate Spacemen needs roughly 7.0 GB of free disk space.

set.tagline: Trust the voice on the radio, then notice it has stopped coming from the same room.
set.description: A free Windows game of space-station suspicion, shapeshifting and very bad rescue shifts. Play online or on a LAN in 16-player Shapeshifter matches, or take a smaller crew through Story and Survival co-op. Steam installs the client; its separate Windows dedicated server requires a unique Steam game-server login token.
set.developerName: Geoff 'Zag' Keene and Deep Field Games
set.launcherInstall.note: The free Steam app 408900 provides the Windows client and updates. PlayBound can request its install and detect the game executable, but the full detect/launch flow still requires a live test. Dedicated hosting is a separate Windows SteamCMD tool (app 824240), requires a unique game-server login token per server, and is not yet provisioned on the PlayBound VPS. No native controller support is advertised on the official store page; do not offer a verified controller profile yet.

min.notes: The developer lists Windows 7 x64 for the game, but the current Steam client requires Windows 10 or newer. Broadband is required for online play.

qualityBar.verdict: A room full of convincing voices becomes wonderfully unreliable the moment someone stops answering from where they should be.

set.longDescription:
The Company sends its spacemen to failing outposts and expects them to complete a job before rescue arrives. That would be an ordinary shift if one of them were not a monster wearing a colleague's face. Unfortunate Spacemen gets its best moments from the gap between what players say and what they can prove. You might hear a familiar voice through a doorway, see someone turn a corner, and realize those two details no longer fit together. The game gives you weapons and objectives, but suspicion is the thing everyone carries into the next room.

Shapeshifter Mode supports up to 16 players. Human crew members complete randomized tasks, call for extraction and decide whether to move together or risk separating. The Monster can impersonate players, set traps and choose when to abandon its disguise for a direct attack. A Traitor can help it from inside the crew. Proximity voice chat makes distance matter: a conversation fades as someone walks away, which can be useful information or a perfect way to disappear without announcing it. The developers put the trouble in 15 alien locations, from outposts and stations to a hypertrain and dig site. Security guard bots can help fill a match, but they are no substitute for friends who can accuse one another with conviction.

There are two ways to play with a smaller, more cooperative group. Story Mode pits up to six players against a hostile insect swarm. Survival Mode lets up to ten players face escalating waves. Both remove some of the social deduction pressure while keeping the same frantic shooting and communication. Steam also lists LAN PvP and LAN co-op, so a local group can use the game's own network modes. A PlayBound party can gather friends around a session, but an automatic lobby or invite handoff has not been verified. Use the in-game multiplayer flow for now.

The Windows client is free on Steam, app 408900. Steam handles its installation and updates; PlayBound can request that install and look for the executable afterward. We have not yet completed an end-to-end detection and launch test. The game's separate dedicated server is Windows-only, distributed as SteamCMD app 824240. Its official setup guide requires a unique Steam game-server login token for each server. That is a real hosting path, but it is not a PlayBound VPS recipe yet, so we should not sell or advertise instant PlayBound hosting for it.

The official store lists no native controller support, and we have not tested a PlayBound Controls mapping. Keyboard and mouse remain the dependable choice. The game requires about 7 GB free, 4 GB RAM minimum, a GTX 470 class GPU and DirectX 11; an 8 GB system with a GTX 960 class GPU is recommended. It remains Draft until installation, controller behavior and party setup are tested. The reason to keep watching it is simple: few free games make a normal sounding reply feel so suspicious.
set.whyWePickedIt: Its free Shapeshifter matches make proximity chat and incomplete information the heart of the game, while Story and Survival give friends two co-op alternatives. The Windows server path is documented, but PlayBound hosting still needs its own tested recipe.
set.thatOneThing: The monster can borrow your friend's face; proximity chat lets you hear your friend's voice wandering away from where they said they were.

installSteps.text: Install the free Unfortunate Spacemen Steam app (408900). Steam supplies the Windows client and updates; no third-party download is needed.

Launch once through Steam. PlayBound can look for UnfortunateSpacemen.exe afterward; if it does not detect the install, choose Locate and select the game executable. Detection still needs a live test.

firstPlaySteps.text: Check audio and microphone settings before a Shapeshifter match. Proximity voice chat is part of how players track, mislead and lose one another.

multiplayerGamingSteps.text: For up to 16 players, create or join a Shapeshifter lobby in-game. Story supports up to six total players; Survival supports up to ten. Steam also lists LAN modes. PlayBound can organize your party, but automatic lobby joining has not been verified.

Self-hosting uses the separate Windows Dedicated Server SteamCMD app (824240) and a unique Steam game-server login token for each instance. PlayBound VPS hosting has not been provisioned or verified for this game.

faq.a: Yes. The base Windows game is free to play on Steam. Optional purchases do not change the free client install.
Shapeshifter supports up to 16 players; Story supports six total; Survival supports ten total.
The official Steam page does not advertise controller support, and PlayBound has not verified a Controls profile. Use keyboard and mouse for now.

faq.q: Can PlayBound host a dedicated server?
faq.a: The developer offers a Windows dedicated server through SteamCMD, but it requires a unique Steam game-server login token and is not yet a tested PlayBound-hosted recipe.

bestFor: Friends who enjoy social deduction with actual shooting
Groups who want a free 16-player night or smaller co-op modes
notFor: Players expecting one-click PlayBound dedicated hosting today
